correctness.rationale: For every \(m\ge3\), the peripheral induced graph is m disjoint edges, producing a full simplex. Each one-pole link has precisely the faces with |T|+|T∩S|<=2 and collapses, via free pairs using any b_k outside each chosen a_i,a_j pair, to a join with a simplex. Thus the union Y of the peripheral simplex and two cones is contractible. All both-pole faces form a second contractible J, with invariant intersection \(K_{2,2m}\). CW homotopy pushout gives a wedge of \(2m-1\) two-spheres. Integral Mayer-Vietoris naturality gives H2 exactly the complete-bipartite cycle lattice \(I_U\otimes I_W\); signed action and fixed rank follow by explicit tensor calculation. Standalone verify.py from the same package enumerated all \(m=3,4,5\) faces, checked all collapse pairs, mod-two Betti ranks and all 300 signed group-element Lefschetz traces. Finite checks do not substitute for the uniform proof.

originality.rationale: The full 2020 foundational higher-independence text (arXiv:2001.05448) covers complete multipartite, fully whiskered, path/cycle and perfect-tree families; a quadrilateral book of three or more pages is none of these. The inspected 2020 domination paper gives connectivity and a chordal theorem, whereas the target contains induced four-cycles and its exact integer representation is not implied. The 2021 chordal/caterpillar paper similarly does not cover this graph, and the 2023 categorical-product ordinary-independence results concern a different product and cutoff. Actual published-finding corpus semantic searches on the book, four-cycle, graph-product, homology and symmetry aliases identified relevant but different invariants (matching complexes of quadrilateral books; three-nonmatching complexes of vertex-bouquets of squares). No inspected statement implies the complete integral module or even the stated exact sphere count. Remaining risk: unindexed equivalent or unstated larger reduction.
residual_risks: An uncatalogued third-independence computation or equivalent generalized-book theorem may exist.

value.rationale: Classifies the homotopy and complete integral page-permutation/layer-reversal representation for an infinite natural family of nonchordal quadrilateral books. The unexpectedly dimension-stable two-sphere wedge, linearly increasing \(2m-1\) multiplicity, and one primitive fixed class are precise structural answers not implied by generic chordal or graph-product results. The contractible-cover-to-\(K_{2,2m}\) reduction explains the topology rather than merely enumerating finite cases. The exact integral symmetry object has natural applications to the homology of automorphism quotients; no downstream theorem is required for this motivated exact classification.
